terms.definition: to face or deal with difficulties
terms.example: There is no way around it – eventually you will have to deal with that bully at school.

terms.definition: (about a description of something) powerful and effective
(here) to have in mind, to think about something for a long time
terms.example: Gill has thought of quitting her job for over a month now.

terms.definition: people of the same age or social position
terms.example: I recall back in school days my classmates' opinion was the most important thing for me.

terms.definition: to force something out of its usual place
terms.example: This species was eventually forced out by a more numerous one.
